prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 用药说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "药品名称" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "规格" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 102px
  col 3: header "用法用量" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 109px
  col 4: header "频次" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 64px
  col 5: header "注意事项" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 521px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查看每种药品的规格、用法用量、服药频次和注意事项。","reading":"读者先按药品名称定位，再横向读取同一行的给药信息和注意事项；比较药品时，也会纵向扫描规格、频次及注意事项。","groups":["药品名称和规格共同标识药品及其包装。","用法用量和频次共同说明如何及何时用药，应便于连续阅读。","注意事项是较长的说明文字，适合分配较多宽度，并与对应药品行保持清晰关联。"],"keep_intact":["药品名称应尽量完整显示，避免拆散名称中的字母和数字。","规格中的数值、单位及乘号组合，以及用量中的数值和单位，应尽量保持完整。","每日频次等短语宜保持在一行。"],"may_wrap":["注意事项可在自然语句边界或中文词语之间换行。","用法用量可在给药方式与剂量之间换行。","较长的注意事项已会增加行高，同一行的药品名称或规格换行可利用这部分高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [129, 123, 130, 85, 252] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [129, 123, 110, 85, 272] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [129, 110, 120, 85, 275] · table 720×299px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"药品名称、规格、用法用量和频次均保持单行，横向读取和纵向比较都顺畅；注意事项虽较长，仍与对应药品行清楚关联。","problems":"注意事项第二行末尾的“5”和第三行的“天。”被拆开，第三条也以单独的“复查。”收尾，文字节奏略显零碎。","cause":"注意事项列为252px，文字可用宽度为231px；其余四列按单行内容分配，占用了较多宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"药品名称、规格和频次保持单行；注意事项列比r1A宽，表格总高度没有增加。","problems":"多条用法用量被拆成两行，出现单独的“2粒”“粒”和“服”，剂量与给药方式的连续性变差；注意事项仍有短尾行。","cause":"用法用量列从130px缩至110px，文字可用宽度仅89px，不足以容纳这些完整短语；注意事项列增至272px仍不足以消除所有短尾行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"药品名称和频次保持单行；注意事项列是三个方案中最宽的。","problems":"规格多处把数量与“粒”或“片”拆开，用法用量也有短尾行；最后一行因此增高，纵向比较规格更费力。","cause":"规格列缩至110px，文字可用宽度为89px；用法用量列120px也不足以容纳所有完整短语。节省出的宽度给了注意事项，但没有换来足够明显的阅读收益。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[124,123,130,85,257],"change":"以r1A为基础，从药品名称列取5px给注意事项，保留规格、用法用量和频次的单行宽度；检查名称是否仍完整，以及注意事项断行是否改善。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[129,123,125,85,257],"change":"从用法用量列取5px给注意事项，保留药品名称与规格的完整宽度；检查较小幅度的调整能否兼顾用量短语和注意事项的断行。"}]}
